title: Citizen Weather Observation Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Seismograph (`seismo:reading`), Geiger counter (`geiger:cpm`), lightning strikes (`lightning:strike`), radon (`radon:reading`), all-sky meteor camera (`allsky:capture`), river-level gauge (`riverlevel:reading`), magnetometer (`magnetometer:reading`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`).
app: DIY citizen-science sensors — Raspberry Shake seismograph, Geiger counter, AS3935/Blitzortung lightning detector, radon monitor, all-sky meteor camera, river-level gauge, and magnetometer — via MQTT and scripted inputs to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=citizenweather:obs temp_c=*
| stats sum(temp_c) as total_value, avg(temp_c) as avg_value by station_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks station values by total and average temperature across Citizen Weather observation events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `temp_c` values for each Citizen Weather observation event and review total and average temperature by station.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you which station shows the biggest temperature numbers in your Citizen Weather observation data.
